body.summary: An adult animated spy comedy created by Adam Reed, following Sterling Archer, a vain, heavy-drinking field agent at the International Secret Intelligence Service (ISIS), an agency run by his domineering mother Malory. Episodes pair globe-trotting missions with office farce, insults, running gags and pop-culture pastiche. From season five the show turns to season-long genre pastiches: a drug cartel (Archer: Vice), 1940s noir (Dreamland), a 1930s South Seas adventure (Danger Island) and deep space (Archer 1999). Archer wakes from a three-year coma to a changed agency, which is later folded into the corporate giant IIA under Fabian Kingsworth, then rebuilt as a boutique branch with Lana as director before a UN ban on private spy agencies ends it. ||The series ends with the agency outlawed, Archer going rogue, and Lana hired to bring him in.||

arcs.summary: Sterling fakes a mole hunt to cover his expenses and the real mole Krenshaw surfaces.
ISIS is shut down for treason; the cast turns the seized cocaine into a cartel, loses it piece by piece, and ends up in San Marcos.

arcs.summary: Archer's on-off relationship with Lana, from exes to co-parents of AJ.
The agency's repeated near-collapse and reinvention, from ISIS to CIA contractors to private detectives.
Barry's transformation into a cyborg and his vendetta against Archer.
Archer's three-year coma and the dream-season pastiches, then his return to a changed agency.
The rivalry with the IIA and Fabian Kingsworth over the ionic fusion device.
The Agency launches as an IIA subsidiary; Archer wins the Agent Skills Competition but Lana is made head, and Fabian's kidnapping stunt is revealed as a leadership demo.
A jungle mission to recover medical supplies from the warlord Serpiente collapses into a plane crash and snakebite, and the team learns Fabian is using them.
A Saturday mission to escort the Broker turns into a standoff with the mafia, yakuza and Russian mob while Pam babysits AJ at the office.
The team chases the Swiss mercenary Alessia and the magnetic pulse device Helga; Alessia defects to Pam's side.
arcs.locator: third block, S13E04 Laws of Attraction

arcs.summary: An intervention for Archer's drinking becomes a race to save his therapist from IIA assassins; the therapist, named Malory Lacania, offers to run away with him.
arcs.locator: third block, S13E05 Out of Network

arcs.summary: A bank vault job for Fabian turns out to be blackmail material that destabilizes Manatina; the team learns Fabian has been using them.
Framed as fugitives, the team runs a distraction relay so Lana can attend AJ's custody hearing, then flees to Cheryl's plane.
In Manatina the team tries to assassinate Fabian, Ray is revealed as a double agent, and Fabian escapes with the rare earth metal hexon.
arcs.locator: third block, S13E08 Dough Ray and Me

arcs.summary: Lana takes over the Agency and takes on Interpol work; Zara Khan is revealed as a rogue Interpol agent who hires the team to catch the Vanguard.
The team is captured by the Vanguard, escapes a flooding sea cave, and destroys the Vanguard's base; Zara is hired.
A museum job to protect a Golden Plaque becomes a fight with smuggler Ibadan Peters and a fake curse; the plaque is swapped and returned to Nigeria.
Barry returns as a sentient refrigerator and the team fights Other Barry at Yucca Mountain.
A mission in Ibiza against a cocaine kingpin becomes a vacation; Archer's Domingo persona and Lana's sobriety are tested.
At a Costa Rican plastic surgery resort the team hunts the shapeshifting kingpin El Cambiante; Archer survives a fall and believes himself immortal.
Lana's new control center fails during a synchronized hack of the Dragon Run black market, but the teams succeed anyway.
IIA drones hunt former employees; the team breaks Fabian out of a Swiss prison and deactivates the drones at the cost of Fabian's hand.
The UN bans private spy agencies; Slater and Katya's Silverwolf plot to restart the Cold War by blowing up a Sochi dam is stopped, and the Agency disbands.

notable_scenes.summary: Archer breaks into ISIS to fix his expense account and discovers Krenshaw is the mole.
Archer and Lana disarm a bomb on the airship while Ray talks them through the wires.
The cast is arrested for treason and everyone rats out everyone else in the interrogation room.
Lana gives birth to Abbiejean in a rebel-held airport while Archer waits outside.
Lana tells Archer she used his frozen sperm to conceive.
Archer wakes from his coma and finds Lana married to Robert, learning he has missed three years.

notable_scenes.summary: The office is trapped in an elevator during a team-building exercise and turns on each other.

Archer and Barry fight aboard a ship as it self-destructs.
